Online booking through Telegram

Customers book a stylist, doctor or sports pitch in a free slot themselves and get reminders, so staff stop living on the phone. An MVP in 2–4 weeks, from UZS 24 mln; the full version in 6–10 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Services, staff and schedules
  • Booking, rescheduling and cancelling
  • Reminders a day and an hour before
  • Notifications to a staff group

What the full version adds
  • Prepayment with Click or Payme
  • Several branches

  • A person who takes the orders

Questions

What does “Online booking through Telegram” cost?
The MVP costs $2,000–4,000 (UZS 24–48.5 mln), the full version $6,000–14,000 (UZS 72–169 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Online booking through Telegram” take?
The MVP takes 2–4 weeks, the full version 6–10 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
A company Telegram account for the bot; The list of products or services with prices; A person who takes the orders.
